result_text:
The four broken default conventions now match their intended files. The new tests and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (4 and 6 tests, no failures).

**Changes** in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, in the four pattern constants:
- `GENERATED_HTML_PAGE_PATH_PATTERN`: `(html|html|xhtml)` → `(html|htm|xhtml)`. This covers the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules.
- `DOT_NET_ASSEMBLY_DOC_XML_PATH_PATTERN`: `.*/[.]xml` → `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- `GENERATED_JS_PATH_PATTERN`: `.*/[.]js` → `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- `GRADLE_JS_PATH_PATTERN`: `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` → `.*-gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

Path patterns are matched against the whole path, so the old leading `/` and the literal `.` in front of the name were what blocked real files. The new patterns still match everything the old ones matched, and hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files only enter these scopes when their content rule also matches.

**New test:** `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java` checks each constant against files that should and should not match.

I did not commit anything.

One thing I noticed but did not change, since it was outside the four typos: the meta-generator content pattern `[ ]*[<]meta name[=]"generator" .*` only matches when the `<meta` tag starts its line, so a tag placed after other markup on the same line would not match. Say if you want that loosened too.
